label: TP
reason: The XSS alerts point to concatenating user-supplied cookie values directly into HTML output via response.getWriter().println() without encoding. The code extracts cookie values from request (potentially user-controllable) and embeds them unescaped in the response body, enabling XSS. While there is also an insecure random number generator usage, the primary focus of the finding is the XSS vulnerability which clearly meets TP criteria.

evidence.note: User cookie values are concatenated directly into HTML response without encoding, creating XSS risk
